name: project-management-system
description: Project & task management system — web (React), Android (Expo) and a single Express + PostgreSQL API

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pms/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @pms/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:shared && npm run start -w @pms/mobile
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:shared && npm run db:migrate -w @pms/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build:shared && npm run db:seed -w @pms/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pms/api && npm run build -w @pms/web
